mechanism_narrative: ERBB2-MET forced proximity via flexible_GS4 linker (~20 Å) biases signaling through GRB2-SHC1-SOS-RAS-MAPK and GAB1-PIK3R1-AKT axes, while sterically excluding PLCG1 due to the 278 aa ECD asymmetry that misaligns the kinase domains for productive PLCγ docking. The biased output upregulates muscle structural/contractile genes (ACTA2, MYL9, MYH11, MYOM2, TAGLN) via SRF/ELK1 downstream of MAPK, and downregulates aged-marker immediate early genes (EGR1, FOS, JUN) and inflammatory/stress genes (IL32, TXNIP, OTUD1) characteristic of aged muscle. MET's known role in myoblast migration and survival synergizes with ERBB2's proliferative/survival signaling to produce a rejuvenating transcriptome shift.
